## Summary

Describe the behavior or invariant changed by this pull request.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --all-features --locked`

- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed operational or security boundary

## Security / reliability impact

Describe changes to routing, identity, request signing, retry behavior, rate limiting, circuit breaking, resource bounds, TLS assumptions, or dependency policy. Write `None` only when none of these are affected.
